papers.title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
papers.summary: CausalAlign improves long-horizon camera ego-motion consistency in diffusion video generators by aligning internal representations to 3D dynamics via delta-token space.

papers.title: AV-FABLE: Audio-Visual Manipulation Forensics in Long-Form Videos
papers.summary: AV-FABLE introduces a long-form audio-visual benchmark for sparse manipulations, showing that frozen perception features of audio-visual large language models contain forensic evidence best recovered via separate temporal decoders rather than language outputs.

papers.title: More Memory, Better Videos? A Controlled Study of Visual Memory in Long-Video Generation
papers.summary: Visual memory improves historical consistency but can reduce current-story accuracy by reinforcing outdated appearances, showing that retrieval relevance alone does not prove memory utility.

papers.title: RoboHarness: A Simple Harness Outperforms VLA and World Action Models
papers.summary: RoboHarness enables LLM agents to perform embodied manipulation via a visual-geometric control interface, surpassing specialized vision-language-action models on robotics benchmarks.
